summary: Frontend-only UI verification of mobile declutter changes across Builder + Library at 390x844 mobile and 1920x1080 desktop. Seeded one TEST_MOBILE_UI character (via New + Randomize + Save) then tested Builder overflow kebab, DNA at-a-glance auto-collapse, Library card compact layout, and desktop-vs-mobile regressions. All four MVP behaviors from the review request work as expected. One test-cleanup delete confirmation was auto-accepted. Backend tests NOT re-run per instruction (iteration_5 already 16/16 green).
critical_code_review_comments: MobileOverflow renders children TWICE in the DOM (once inside hidden `sm:contents` desktop wrapper, once inside the mobile floating panel). Both copies carry the same data-testid. Playwright's `page.click('[data-testid=btn-randomize-wet-dream]')` therefore resolves to 2 elements and picks the first (hidden desktop copy) causing a `not visible` failure. Recommend either: (a) only render the panel copy on <sm via CSS media query on a single element, or (b) suffix testids inside the panel (e.g. `btn-randomize-wet-dream-mobile`) so tests can target them unambiguously. Same issue affects btn-randomize-all, btn-toggle-raunch, btn-export-json, btn-import-json, btn-open-shoot on mobile.

Library character cards are missing the `data-testid=card-archetype`, `data-testid=card-prompt-preview`, and `data-testid=card-tag-*` attributes referenced in the review checklist. The elements DO exist and render/hide correctly per breakpoint (visually confirmed via screenshots) but adding testids would enable stable regression coverage.
Library cards on desktop currently render the FULL prompt string (600+ chars) as the preview, causing very tall cards. Consider truncating to a fixed line-clamp (e.g. `line-clamp-3`) even at sm+.

MobileOverflow closes the panel on any click inside via `onClick={() => setOpen(false)}` on the panel div. That works for buttons but means the panel dismisses even if the user click-drags to select text or misses the button — minor UX polish item.
action_items: Consider fixing MobileOverflow duplicate-render pattern so testids are unique (see review comments).
Add data-testid=card-archetype / card-prompt-preview / card-tag-* to Library cards for regression tests.
Add line-clamp to prompt preview on desktop cards to prevent tall-card overflow.
